_comment: The composer's section catalogue. One entry = one .html skeleton (see README.md). The composer filters by `type` (according to the trade's playbook) + `mood`, picks a `layout` variant, and adapts the prospect's real content into it with its font pair + palette. v1 curated by hand; to enrich by extraction (extractize).

sections.layout: editorial heading on the left + tall image on the right (asymmetric grid)
sections.motion: cascading reveal of the heading + image fade
sections.useWhen: premium trade, at least 1 strong photo

sections.layout: full-screen edge-to-edge image + heading + CTA overlaid bottom-left
sections.motion: light image zoom + reveal of the text block
sections.useWhen: visual trade (kitchen, pool, venue, landscaper) with a superb hero photo

sections.layout: two 50/50 columns: promise + CTA on one side, media on the other, full height
sections.motion: staggered reveal of the two columns
sections.useWhen: service/technical trade, 0-1 photo, a text/visual balance needed

sections.layout: 3-4 numbered steps in a row (grid), big numbers, short titles
sections.useWhen: a clear process to show (design → manufacture → installation)

sections.layout: vertical timeline on the left (steps) + sticky media on the right
sections.useWhen: a narrative process with a supporting image/video

sections.layout: grid of projects in 2-3 columns, regular ratios, discreet captions
sections.useWhen: ≥ 6 sharp project photos

sections.layout: variable-height mosaic (masonry) edge-to-edge
sections.motion: reveal on scroll + light zoom on hover
sections.useWhen: many photos of varied formats

sections.layout: one project shown big (feature) + 3-4 thumbnails aligned below
sections.motion: fade of the feature + reveal of the thumbnails
sections.useWhen: 1 flagship project to put forward + a few others

sections.layout: an aligned band of partner logos, neutral, on a discreet contrasting background
sections.useWhen: brands/partners present in the fiche (never invented)

sections.layout: wide editorial text on the left + portrait/workshop on the right, asymmetric
sections.useWhen: a story/craft to tell, 1 workshop/team photo

sections.layout: an honest owner card (name, role, 2 lines) with no fake photo, + a real link
sections.useWhen: put a face/a human signature forward without inventing a photo

sections.layout: 3 reviews as cards, quote + name + clickable source (Google/Trustpilot)
sections.useWhen: real reviews/ratings available (never invented)

sections.layout: video-testimonial thumbnails (click-to-load YouTube facade) + 1 strong quote alongside
sections.useWhen: real video testimonials (YouTube/Vimeo) exist

sections.layout: 3-4 guarantees as chips/short cards (10-year guarantee, free quote, financing)
sections.useWhen: reassurance: real guarantees/financing

sections.layout: a wide editorial list, 1 service per line (title + 1 sentence), a rule between lines
sections.useWhen: services to present with editorial clarity

sections.layout: a grid of service cards (Lucide icon + title + short text)
sections.useWhen: 3-6 distinct services to present visually

sections.layout: a full-width band, strong heading + subtitle + booking button + phone, strongly centred
sections.useWhen: a strong conversion moment (book an appointment / quote)

sections.layout: a sober horizontal band: sentence + button on the right
sections.useWhen: a discreet conversion reminder mid-page

sections.layout: a list of the areas served (towns) in columns + the main town put forward
sections.useWhen: local SEO: areas/towns served

sections.layout: a row of 3-4 key figures (big number + label), separating rules
sections.useWhen: real, credible figures (years, projects, reviews)

sections.layout: questions/answers in a native accordion (<details>), wide, sober
sections.useWhen: lift the frequent objections (lead times, prices, guarantees)
